units.source_text: 那个穿着藏青色短上衣的匪徒侮辱了我之后，又嘲笑我那被绑在杉树上的丈夫，

en.t: After the bandit in the dark blue short jacket violated me, he even mocked my husband, who was tied to the cedar tree,

units.source_text: 我丈夫内心是多么的悲愤啊！

en.t: How full of grief and rage my husband's heart must have been!

units.source_text: 然而不管他怎么挣扎，都无法摆脱捆着他的绳子。

en.t: Yet no matter how he struggled, he could not break free of the ropes that bound him.

units.source_text: 我连滚带爬的滚到丈夫身侧——没有，我是想要跑过去的。

en.t: I rolled and crawled to my husband's side, no, I meant to run to him.

units.source_text: 但是那个匪徒上来就把我踢翻了。

en.t: But the bandit came over and kicked me down at once.

units.source_text: 这个时候，我看到丈夫眼里迸发出一种无法形容的光。

en.t: At that moment, I saw an indescribable light burst from my husband's eyes.

units.source_text: 无法形容——到今天，我想起他的眼神来都觉得恐惧。

en.t: Indescribable, even today, remembering his eyes fills me with terror.

units.source_text: 丈夫一言不发，但是就那一瞬间，他用他的眼神将他的心意传递给我了。

en.t: My husband did not say a word, but in that one instant he conveyed his heart to me through his gaze.

units.source_text: 但是他眼神，不是愤怒也不是悲哀，

en.t: But his gaze was neither anger nor sorrow,

units.source_text: 而且冰冷的蔑视我的光啊！

en.t: but a cold light that looked at me with contempt!

units.source_text: 那匪徒的一脚没有什么，
但丈夫的眼神让我万念俱灰，

en.t: but my husband's gaze reduced every hope in me to ashes,

units.source_text: 我惊讶一声，便昏倒在地。

en.t: I gave a startled cry and fainted to the ground.
